content: Standard practice for testing DB-dependent code without a CI server is Testcontainers: spin up a real, ephemeral Postgres (Docker) per test run, apply real migrations, assert against real Postgres-specific behavior, then discard; works identically locally and in CI once CI exists. For a project whose tests must not touch the real garden and currently has no CI at all, the load-bearing requirement is that the ephemeral instance is provably isolated (ephemeral container/tmp data dir + random port) and that this same harness runs identically pre-CI (local) and post-CI, so adding CI later is not a redesign.
